## The Agentic SaaS Course

### Overview
A 52-hour, principles-first course on building software with AI. Not toy demos — students ship 4 real products across 4 tiers, internalize 8 timeless principles, and build the judgment to know when AI is helping and when it's hiding a lack of understanding.

The tools change every six months. The principles do not.

### Course Structure

**Prework** (2 hours, 3 lessons)
Set up local environment, deployment pipeline, and AI tooling.

**Tier 1 — Foundations** (8 hours, 10 lessons)
Learn the fundamentals that transfer across any AI tool: tokens, context windows, skills, MCP servers, and the tool ladder from paste to agent. Understand the 8 principles and deploy your first AI-assisted tool.
- Tokens, context windows, and how AI tools actually work
- The tool ladder: paste → skill → script → agent → MCP
- Reading before generating, spec writing, error-first debugging
- First three principles internalized through real work
- **Capstone**: Deployed single-page tool
- **Technologies**: Tokens, Skills, MCP, Claude Code

**Tier 2 — Builder** (12 hours, 12 lessons)
Build a full CRUD SaaS with auth, database, and payments. Learn to spec before you generate, test what matters, and ship to real users.
- Full-stack SaaS with Next.js, Supabase, and Stripe
- Spec-driven development with AI assistance
- Database design with Drizzle ORM
- Production deployment and monitoring
- **Capstone**: Working SaaS product deployed to Vercel
- **Technologies**: Next.js, Supabase, Stripe, Drizzle

**Tier 3 — Operator** (15 hours, 14 lessons)
Ship a product with real users. Handle production incidents. Write postmortems. Learn background jobs with Inngest and end-to-end testing.
- Production operations and incident response
- Background jobs and event-driven architecture
- End-to-end testing with Vitest and Playwright
- Postmortem writing and operational maturity
- **Capstone**: Live product with users and documentation
- **Technologies**: Inngest, Vitest, Playwright, Operations

**Tier 4 — Architect** (15 hours, 12 lessons)
Tear down a complex system. Evaluate every decision. Write a system teardown document that proves you can think at the architectural level.
- System architecture analysis and documentation
- Trade-off evaluation and decision frameworks
- The complete teardown methodology
- Principle 8: taste is the moat
- **Capstone**: System teardown document proving architectural judgment
- **Technologies**: Architecture, Analysis, Documentation, Judgment

### 8 Principles
The course teaches 8 timeless principles for building software with AI, including:
- Judgment over prompt tricks
- Principles over patterns
- Builders, not prompters
- Shipping real products
- Taste is the moat

### Student Testimonials

## Projects

### Predictive (Augure)
AI-Powered Prediction Platform. Enterprise-grade prediction intelligence platform that models complex interdependencies across 17 life domains. Features a 230-field user profiling system, hierarchical ontology with 1,000+ domain nodes, Monte Carlo simulations, and real-time analytics dashboard. Built entirely solo from architecture through deployment.
- Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Python, Vercel
- Metrics: 98 Lighthouse Score, <200ms P95 API Response, 47KB Initial Bundle

### MyUrbanFarm.ai
Urban Farming Management Platform. Comprehensive digital platform connecting urban farmers, corporate sponsors, and administrators to manage sustainable rooftop farming initiatives. Real-time tracking, analytics, and multi-stakeholder collaboration.
- Tech: React, TypeScript, Supabase, Interactive Mapping

### NxSupabase
Official Nx Plugin for Supabase. Streamlines Supabase integration within monorepo environments. Automates database migrations, TypeScript type generation, and local development setup with zero configuration.
- Tech: Nx, TypeScript, Supabase, Docker
